name: Global Travel POI Verified Dataset
description: Curated database of verified real-world attractions, cultural landmarks, parks, and dining districts with geocoordinates and weather suitability tags

tokyo.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
tokyo.description: 58.3-hectare national garden blending traditional Japanese, English landscape, and French formal styles.

tokyo.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
tokyo.description: Majestic Shinto shrine dedicated to Emperor Meiji, enclosed within a 170-acre evergreen forest in Shibuya.

tokyo.name: Tokyo National Museum (Ueno)
tokyo.description: Japan's oldest and largest museum housing over 110,000 cultural artifacts and National Treasures.
tokyo.source: OpenStreetMap / National Institutes for Cultural Heritage

tokyo.name: Senso-ji Temple & Nakamise-dori
tokyo.description: Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple founded in 645 AD, approached via the vibrant Nakamise shopping avenue.

tokyo.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
tokyo.description: Bustling historic food district filled with hundreds of seafood stalls, sushi counters, and tamagoyaki chefs.

tokyo.name: Mori Art Museum & Roppongi Hills
tokyo.description: Contemporary art museum perched on the 53rd floor of Roppongi Hills Mori Tower with observation deck.

tokyo.name: Shibuya Sky Observation Deck
tokyo.description: Open-air rooftop observatory 229 meters above Shibuya Crossing offering 360-degree vistas of Mt. Fuji and Tokyo skyline.

tokyo.name: Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane)
tokyo.description: Intimate post-war alleyway near Shinjuku Station packed with traditional yakitori and izakaya establishments.

tokyo.name: teamLab Planets Tokyo
tokyo.description: Immersive digital museum where visitors walk barefoot through water and interact with colossal light art installations.

tokyo.name: Akihabara Electric Town & Radio Kaikan
tokyo.description: Global hub for electronics, computing hardware, anime, and multi-story retro gaming arcades.

tokyo.name: Ueno Onshi Park & Shinobazu Pond
tokyo.description: Sprawling public park famed for its lotus pond, cherry blossoms, and adjacent cultural institutions.

tokyo.name: Ginza Six & Shopping Promenade
tokyo.description: Premier luxury complex featuring rooftop Japanese gardens, Noh theater, and flagship designer boutiques.

paris.name: Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars
paris.description: Gustave Eiffel's 330-meter wrought-iron landmark and surrounding public park along the Quai Branly.

paris.name: Musée du Louvre
paris.description: World's most visited museum, housing the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and over 38,000 works of art.

paris.name: Musée d'Orsay
paris.description: Beaux-Arts former railway station exhibiting the premier collection of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist masterpieces.

paris.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
paris.description: 23-hectare palace gardens featuring tree-lined promenades, the Medici Fountain, and model sailboat ponds.

paris.name: Marché des Enfants Rouges (Le Marais)
paris.description: Paris' oldest covered food market established in 1615, serving authentic Moroccan, Lebanese, and French bistrot cuisine.

paris.name: Sainte-Chapelle & Conciergerie
paris.description: 13th-century Gothic royal chapel renowned for its breathtaking 15-meter-high stained glass windows.

paris.name: Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Basilica
paris.description: Historic bohemian hilltop neighborhood featuring street artists, panoramic vistas of Paris, and Romano-Byzantine basilica.

paris.name: Seine Riverboat Cruise (Pont Neuf)
paris.description: Evening navigation past illuminated monuments including Notre-Dame, Musée d'Orsay, and the Eiffel Tower.

paris.name: Centre Pompidou
paris.description: High-tech architectural marvel hosting Europe's largest modern and contemporary art museum.

paris.name: Jardin des Tuileries
paris.description: Historic public garden created by Catherine de' Medici connecting the Louvre with Place de la Concorde.

rome.name: Colosseum & Roman Forum
rome.description: Iconic Flavian amphitheatre completed in 80 AD and adjacent civic center of ancient imperial Rome.

rome.name: Pantheon
rome.description: Remarkably preserved ancient temple with the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome and central oculus.

rome.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
rome.description: Pontifical art collections spanning classical sculptures, Raphael Rooms, and Michelangelo's Sistine ceiling.

rome.name: Piazza Navona & Fountain of the Four Rivers
rome.description: Baroque public square built on the Stadium of Domitian, centered on Bernini's Fontana dei Quattro Fiumi.

rome.name: Campo de' Fiori Market & Trattorias
rome.description: Historic vibrant piazza with daytime produce and spice vendors, surrounded by artisan pasta and carbonara eateries.

rome.name: Villa Borghese Gardens & Galleria Borghese
rome.description: 80-hectare landscaped landscape park housing masterpieces by Bernini, Caravaggio, and Canova.

rome.name: Trevi Fountain (Fontana di Trevi)
rome.description: Monumental Late Baroque fountain designed by Nicola Salvi at the terminus of the ancient Aqua Virgo aqueduct.

rome.name: Trastevere Historic Quarter & Osterias
rome.description: Atmospheric medieval cobblestone alleys renowned for authentic Roman osterias, street musicians, and Piazza Santa Maria.

new york.name: Central Park & Bethesda Terrace
new york.description: 843-acre urban oasis designed by Olmsted and Vaux, featuring iconic bridges, the Mall, and Bow Bridge.

new york.name: Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
new york.description: Largest art museum in the Americas, encompassing over 2 million works across 5,000 years of global culture.

new york.name: The High Line & Hudson Yards
new york.description: 1.45-mile elevated parkway on a former historic freight rail line with native prairie gardens and public art.
new york.source: OpenStreetMap / Friends of the High Line

new york.name: Chelsea Market Food Hall
new york.description: Enclosed urban food hall inside the historic Nabisco factory with international food vendors and artisan bakeries.

new york.name: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
new york.description: World-leading modern art museum featuring van Gogh's Starry Night, Warhol, Picasso, and design exhibits.

new york.name: Summit One Vanderbilt
new york.description: Multi-sensory observation experience 1,000+ feet above Midtown Manhattan with mirrored infinity rooms.

new york.name: Brooklyn Bridge & DUMBO Promenade
new york.description: Historic 1883 suspension bridge pedestrian walkway leading to scenic East River waterfront and skyline views.

new york.name: Broadway Theater District
new york.description: World's preeminent commercial theatrical center featuring 41 professional Broadway theaters.

london.name: British Museum
london.description: World-renowned institution dedicated to human history, art and culture, housing the Rosetta Stone and Parthenon Sculptures.

london.name: Tower of London & Tower Bridge
london.description: Historic royal fortress founded in 1066, home to the Crown Jewels and Yeoman Warders beside the iconic bascule bridge.

london.name: Borough Market
london.description: London's premier historic food market dating to the 12th century, serving artisan British cheeses, street food, and oysters.

london.name: Hyde Park & Kensington Gardens
london.description: 350-acre Royal Park featuring the Serpentine lake, Memorial Fountain, and Kensington Palace.

london.name: Tate Modern & Millennium Bridge
london.description: Britain's national gallery of international modern art housed in the repurposed Bankside Power Station.

london.name: West End & Covent Garden
london.description: Vibrant cultural hub filled with street performers, covered Apple Market, opera houses, and West End theatres.

dubai.name: Burj Khalifa & At the Top
dubai.description: World's tallest skyscraper (828m) offering high-speed elevators and panoramic observation decks.

dubai.name: Museum of the Future
dubai.description: Toroidal architectural masterpiece showcasing futuristic technologies, space innovation, and ecological bio-displays.

dubai.name: Dubai Miracle Garden
dubai.description: World's largest natural flower garden featuring 150 million blooming flowers formed into sculptures.

dubai.name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood & Spice Souk
dubai.description: Historic wind-tower quarter along Dubai Creek, traditional abra boat rides, and vibrant spice and gold markets.

dubai.name: Time Out Market Dubai (Souk Al Bahar)
dubai.description: Curated culinary destination featuring top local homegrown chefs overlooking the Dubai Fountain.

delhi.name: Humayun's Tomb
delhi.description: UNESCO World Heritage Mughal garden tomb built in 1570, precursing the architectural design of the Taj Mahal.

delhi.name: National Museum of India (Janpath)
delhi.description: Premier museum housing Harappan civilization treasures, Buddhist relics, miniature paintings, and historical artifacts.

delhi.name: Qutub Minar & Mehrauli Archaeological Park
delhi.description: 73-meter fluted red sandstone minaret dating to 1192 AD surrounded by ancient Indo-Islamic monuments.

delhi.name: Chandni Chowk & Paranthe Wali Gali
delhi.description: Centuries-old culinary and bazaar thoroughfare famed for stuffed parathas, jalebis, and Old Delhi street delicacies.

delhi.name: Lodhi Gardens
delhi.description: 90-acre historic park containing architectural mausoleums of the Sayyid and Lodi dynasties set among lawns.

delhi.name: India Gate & Kartavya Path Promenade
delhi.description: 42-meter triumphal arch war memorial illuminated at dusk with sprawling pedestrian lawns and water channels.

hyderabad.name: Golconda Fort & Sound and Light Show
hyderabad.description: Massive medieval fortress renowned for acoustic engineering, diamond vault history, and panoramic citadel views.

hyderabad.name: Salar Jung Museum
hyderabad.description: One of India's three National Museums, boasting 38 galleries of rare global art, European clocks, and the Veiled Rebecca.

hyderabad.name: Charminar & Laad Bazaar
hyderabad.description: 1591 monument with four grand arches and minarets, surrounded by the historic lacquer bangle and pearl bazaar.

hyderabad.name: Chowmahalla Palace
hyderabad.description: Opulent palace of the Nizams featuring neoclassical Khilwat Mubarak durbar hall and vintage car collection.

hyderabad.name: Famous Biryani at Paradise / Shah Ghouse
hyderabad.description: Traditional Hyderabadi Dum Biryani slow-cooked with basmati rice, aromatic spices, and tender meat.

hyderabad.name: Hussain Sagar Lake & Necklace Road
hyderabad.description: Scenic heart-shaped artificial lake with the world's tallest monolithic Buddha statue and evening boat cruises.

bangalore.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden & Glass House
bangalore.description: 240-acre botanical garden founded by Hyder Ali, featuring century-old trees and a 19th-century Crystal Palace-inspired conservatory.

bangalore.name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum
bangalore.description: Interactive science and engineering museum with engines, space exploration, and biotechnology exhibits.
bangalore.source: OpenStreetMap / National Council of Science Museums

bangalore.name: Bangalore Palace
bangalore.description: Tudor-style royal estate modeled after Windsor Castle, featuring fortified towers and stained-glass interiors.

bangalore.name: Cubbon Park & State Central Library
bangalore.description: 300-acre lush lung of Bangalore with bamboo groves, rose gardens, and colonial red-brick heritage buildings.

bangalore.name: VV Puram Food Street (Thindi Beedi)
bangalore.description: Famous pedestrian food street serving authentic dosas, paddus, Congress bun, and filter coffee.

bangalore.name: UB City Sky Lounge & Promenade
bangalore.description: Luxury commercial precinct with open-air rooftop dining, art galleries, and cityscape vistas.

dharwad.name: Karnatak University Campus & Botanical Garden
dharwad.description: Expansive scenic hilltop campus with verdant botanical gardens and heritage stone academic buildings.

dharwad.name: Chandramouleshwara Temple (Unkal)
dharwad.description: 900-year-old Western Chalukya dynasty stone temple dedicated to Lord Shiva with intricately carved pillars.

dharwad.name: Heritage Lineage Dharwad Peda (Babusingh Thakur)
dharwad.description: Geographical Indication (GI) tagged sweet confection made from caramelized milk and khoya, perfected since 1850.

dharwad.name: Kappatagiri Wildlife Sanctuary & Hill Range
dharwad.description: Rich biodiversity hotspot known for rare medicinal herbs, historic gold mines, and scenic trekking vistas.

dharwad.name: Unkal Lake & Vivekananda Rock
dharwad.description: Centuries-old water reservoir offering sunset pedal boating, gardens, and musical fountain shows.
